scenes.heading: The secret of fast changes
lines: Changing chords quickly is what turns chords into music.
Look for an anchor finger that stays on the same string between two chords.
Move all your fingers together as one shape, and practise slowly — speed comes from accuracy.
Let's practice moving between E minor and A minor.
Focus on smooth transitions — keep your fingers ready and move them together.
Let's practice moving between A major and D major.
Focus on smooth, even transitions — your fingers will get faster with time.
Play along — the app listens, and every smooth change you make brings you closer to sounding great.
